findings.title: prune <-> workspace-sync re-add loop survives PROP-082 for the narrative-cite-audit category
findings.summary: Directive framing (prune not pushing) is refuted. prune pushes deletes daily (Jun 7-12 commits); dome-workspace-sync resurrects them ~1h later. Root cause: PROP-082 is_prune_expired() uses a 14-day DATE proxy for narrative-cite-audit, but prune's policy is COUNT-based (keep_last_n=7, retention_days=null). With ~150-220 narrative-cite-audit files/day, keep-last-7 retains minutes of files while the proxy resurrects 14 days' worth. ~85% of the 457-file / 387MB backlog is this single category.
findings.evidence: Per-file git history of narrative-cite-audit-2026-05-29T0006Z.json shows DELETE(prune)->RE-ADD(workspace-sync) pairs on 6 consecutive days (06-06..06-12). Run sentinels confirmed committed by prune (HTTP 200 @ref=4eedc7f4). All re-adds postdate PROP-082 deploy (2026-06-07).
